description: Corpus for the 'Add a limit in your own words' interpreter. Scored by scripts/eval_interpreter.py; the expectation format is documented there. Snapshot: synthetic Mateo universe (sectors Energy, Financials, Industrials, Information Technology, Utilities).

categories.issuer_cap: Maximum per company, every company: paraphrases
categories.exclusion_sector: Leave out a fund-reported sector label (or its everyday name)
categories.sector_focus: Keep only some sectors: one exclusion per other label
categories.controversy: Leave out companies with controversy-registry records
categories.number_forms: Percentages and quantities in many written forms
categories.hedges_ranges: Hedged numbers, ranges and alternatives: no number taken
categories.multi_condition: Several conditions in one or more sentences
categories.contradiction: Contradictory instructions: question or unsupported, never both rules
categories.nicknames_tickers: Tickers, nicknames and companies not in the data
categories.oil_fossil: Oil and fossil fuels: always a question
